stress_test.blast_radius: Wrong sdk-revision keeps Baseline Ratchet red on every PR to main. Closing 217-219 without a replacement drops the attest and observability bumps. Raising structlog in requirements.txt affects the Docker/pip install path, not only Poetry.
stress_test.rollback: Delete the replacement branch and PR; restore 217-219 by reopening if GitHub allows, otherwise re-push the existing chore/stack-* tips from the ceg-pr-stack worktree. Do not revert origin/main unless the replacement was already merged — then revert that merge commit.
